description: Angular component for device connectivity check dialog in Thingsboard UI, managing telemetry subscriptions, device commands, and UI interactions.

classes.name: DeviceCheckConnectivityDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for checking device connectivity, handling telemetry data, device commands, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, loads device commands, and subscribes to telemetry.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up telemetry subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, optionally saving user preferences.

methods.name: createMarkDownSingleCommand
methods.description: Formats a single command into markdown code block.

methods.name: loadCommands
methods.description: Fetches device telemetry commands and sets allowed transport types.

methods.name: subscribeToLatestTelemetry
methods.description: Subscribes to telemetry data for the device and updates status.

methods.name: selectTabIndexForUserOS
methods.description: Sets UI tab indices based on user's operating system.
